description: Remove Resend email completely from the codebase. Remove from POST /api/sessions/route.ts (the best-effort email block), from registerAction in web/lib/actions/auth.ts (remove sendVerificationEmail import and call, make registration succeed without email verification - mark user as verified immediately or skip the email step), delete or empty web/lib/email/client.ts and web/lib/email/messages.ts, remove resend from package.json, update .env.example and web/README.md, update all affected tests.
steps: 1. In web/app/api/sessions/route.ts: remove the entire 'if (ownerEmail)' block that does 'const { sendResultsEmailTo } = await import("@/lib/email/client")' and the surrounding try/catch. The route should return NextResponse.json({ id }, { status: 201 }) immediately after persistSession succeeds.

2. In web/lib/actions/auth.ts (registerAction): remove the lazy import of sendVerificationEmail from @/lib/email/client. Remove the call to createVerificationToken and sendVerificationEmail for new users (the try/catch block at the end of the new-user path). Remove the similar block in the 'resent' path for unverified existing users. IMPORTANT: registration must still work - since email verification is removed, mark users as verified immediately. In createUser call (web/lib/auth/users.ts already exists - check if it accepts an emailVerifiedAt param) OR simply call markEmailVerified(email) right after createUser succeeds. For the 'resent' path (unverified existing user), remove the token/email sending and just return the same message without sending email.
3. Check web/lib/auth/users.ts to understand createUser signature and whether emailVerifiedAt can be passed. If not, call markEmailVerified right after createUser.
6. Run 'cd web && npm install' to update package-lock.json.
7. Update web/.env.example: remove the 'Envio de correos transaccionales (Resend)' section (RESEND_API_KEY and EMAIL_FROM lines and their comments). Keep all other sections.

8. Update web/README.md: remove references to Resend, email verification step, RESEND_API_KEY. Update the auth flow description: registration now creates a verified account immediately, no email verification step needed.

9. Update web/tests/register-action.test.ts: remove the mock of @/lib/email/client, remove mockSendVerificationEmail references, update test cases - 'registro exitoso' should no longer expect sendVerificationEmail to be called. 'resent' path for unverified user should not expect email sending. Update expectations to match the new flow.
10. Delete web/tests/email-client.test.ts (it tests the deleted email/client.ts).
11. Delete web/tests/email-messages.test.ts (it tests the deleted email/messages.ts).
12. Verify: cd web && npx tsc --noEmit && npm run test -- --run
acceptance_criteria: web/app/api/sessions/route.ts has no import or reference to @/lib/email/client
web/lib/actions/auth.ts has no import or reference to sendVerificationEmail or @/lib/email/client
web/tests/register-action.test.ts is updated and all its tests pass
All remaining tests pass: npm run test -- --run
